title: Code for "Within-Lifetime Coupling, Not Inherited Learning: Minimal Conditions for Emergent Coordination in Independent Agent Populations"
description: Simulation code for a minimal agent-based model in which two architecturally decoupled populations (producers and receivers), sharing no weights, gradients, or optimizer, evolve a shared signal-action code through local reward-based learning and selection. Includes the main experiment, the ODD-protocol model, and ablation harnesses for Lamarckian-vs-Baldwinian inheritance, the producer learning-rate asymmetry, and fitness-mode robustness.
